subject: English
question_text: Fill in the blanks with the words from the box. You may need to change the forms of
stimulus: some of the words. You may need to use one word more than once. 1×10=10 into operator importance an inform invention by of find to Computer is (a) ______ ultra modern electronic device for storing and analysing (b) ______ fed (c) ______ it. It has no capacity (d) ______ do anything (e) ______ itself. It works (f) ______ the basis of commands given by the (g) ______. The (h) ______ of computer has a long history. Computer was not invented overnight. It took long time and hard labour to invent computer. A computer consists (i) ______ five major components. Computer is great (j) ______ us. It renders great service (k) ______ mankind.
guide_solution: Fill in the blanks: (a) an (b) information (c) into (d) by (e) on (f) operator (g) invention (h) of (i) importance (j) to
